text:
oscar: Morning — noticed my net was off. 401k shows twice (2x 5% lines) and state withholding still CA even though I updated my address to NY in Workday last month. Can someone advise?

lina: sorry! can you DM a redacted paystub (last 4 of SSN ok) or paste the earnings/withholdings lines here? we'll triage.

oscar: pasted below (redacted). pay period 02/01-02/15
```
401k pre-tax - 5% - $210.00
401k pre-tax - 5% - $210.00
State tax (CA) - $85.32
Federal tax - $320.10
Net pay - $1579.58
```

jamie - payroll: thanks @oscar. can you confirm last 4 of employee id and employee record effective-date you changed to NY? we had a sync issue with Workday on 02/06 that left some records in CA for payroll run.

oscar: emp id last4 4321. I changed address effective 01/20 and submitted new state withholding form via Workday on 01/22.

lina: hm — payroll logs show address update but withholding form didn't attach. sometimes employees forget the 'submit' step. can you check Workday > Tax Forms and confirm 'Submitted' status?

oscar: checked — shows 'Completed' + confirmation ID WD-8891.

payroll-bot: PAYROLL RUN 1767: processed pay period 02/01-02/15 for ADP connector. Noted 47 exceptions. Reference: PR-2026-02-15-1767.

jamie - payroll: opened ticket with ADP (TICKET-87214) for duplicated 401k deduction and CA tax still applied. Off-cycle refund requested for duplicate 401k amount ($210) and payroll correction to re-run state withholding to NY for next cycle. Also flagged for W-2 adjustment if not corrected by year-end. ETA from ADP: 3 business days for off-cycle refund, payroll correction in next scheduled run.

lina: I'll mark this as high priority and loop in benefits ops for the 401k reversal. Oscar — please keep any follow-up DMs here, and if you get the ADP ticket number reply, drop it in thread. :thumbsup:

oscar: thanks all — appreciate the quick help. tagging @jamie - payroll when ADP confirms.

jamie - payroll: noted. Ticket TICKET-87214. ADP confirmed refund initiated, ref #ADP-5243. I'll post updates here.
